result.title: StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning
result.summary: In fitness and sports training, timely action quality assessment (AQA) is essential for learners to identify and correct technical errors during movement execution. However, most AQA methods assess completed performances, limiting their ability to provide timely feedback. Streaming methods alleviate this latency, but limited reasoning hinders their use of subtle movement cues and sport-specific knowledge. Moreover, their fragmented feedback focuses on one body part at a time, overlooking movement details of other body parts and transitions between action phases. To address these limitations, we propose StreamCoach, a streaming AQA framework under the OnCueCoaching paradigm that couples continuous chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with proactive, evidence-gated coaching. Technique-Aware Reasoning tracks body-part movements and action-phase transitions against sport-specific criteria, while Holistic Coaching integrates accumulated evidence to deliver timely, comprehensive feedback on strengths and technical errors. To support training and benchmarking, we construct EE4D-Stream from 1,213 sports video sequences in Ego-Exo4D through LLM-assisted reannotation and manual review of selected claims, pairing dense CoT annotations with evidence-gated speech content. Building on this dataset, we train StreamCoach using Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning to jointly optimize feedback timing and content. We benchmark 11 offline and streaming baselines on EE4D-Stream, including three proprietary models. StreamCoach achieves state-of-the-art results across intervention timing, action assessment, and coaching quality, surpassing both GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

AI.brief_summary: 提出流式体育动作质量评估框架 StreamCoach：用持续 CoT 追踪身体部位运动与动作阶段转换，并以证据门控的主动反馈整合累积证据，另构建 EE4D-Stream 数据集，用时序-语义对齐强化学习联合优化反馈时机与内容。
AI.relevance_reason: 其证据门控的介入时机与流式证据累积，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 决策、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配；但推理以文本 CoT 为主、面向体育指导应用，与内部 latent 状态表示的机制距离较远，需读原文确认状态与证据如何进入决策。
